record.what_it_does: AI meeting recorder that transcribes and summarizes calls; API exposes meetings, transcripts, summaries, webhooks.
record.auth_notes: Per-user API key from User Settings > API Access (user-scoped). OAuth 2.0 for public apps that other Fathom users install; register via marketplace applications page. Scopes not confirmed (a third party mentions a single public_api scope).
record.access_notes: API key is self-serve from user settings (plan requirement not stated in docs). OAuth apps are "subject to review" for public use/marketplace; whether dev-mode OAuth works for arbitrary users before review is unconfirmed.
record.api_breadth_notes: About 10 REST operations: list meetings, meeting types, get summary, get transcript, request download, download status, list teams, team members, users/permissions, create/delete webhook. TypeScript and Python SDKs.
record.mcp_notes: https://api.fathom.ai/mcp (docs at developers.fathom.ai/mcp-docs; guides for ChatGPT and Claude)
record.blocker_notes: Narrow, mostly read-only API. Public OAuth apps are subject to Fathom review. Plan needed for API access is not documented. No sandbox is mentioned.

evidence.quote: Head to the API Access section of your User Settings and generate an API key.
subject to review to ensure the best experience for all users

record.needs_human: Confirm which Fathom plan includes API access. Confirm whether OAuth apps can be used by non-owner users before marketplace review. Check for any sandbox or test mode. The OAuth scope list is unconfirmed. The docs I fetched are summarized by a fetch model, not read verbatim.
